title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-dbus-proxy security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-94422) in xdg-dbus-proxy allows message filtering bypass via reply serial, which can lead to sandbox escape. xdg-dbus-proxy is a filtering proxy for D-Bus connections, originally part of the flatpak project but now a standalone module. Red Hat has issued an important security update for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 to address this issue.
